definition_summary.expected_curve: exact finite-population expected TTR without replacement
definition_summary.objective: unweighted sum of squared residuals over strictly increasing requested sample sizes
definition_summary.optimizer: analytic derivative with respect to log(D), bracketed by pointwise inverse solutions and bisected exactly 100 times

admission_evidence: independently written R and Python reference implementations agreed
five analytic reference fixtures were recorded
5232 admissible frequency spectra produced no derivative-crossing failure
public API tests cover reference values, permutation invariance, short documents, all-hapax boundaries, and invalid parameters
the installed normative contract freezes fit residual, fitted curve, iteration, derivative, and near-saturation diagnostics
release_evidence_required: R-release and R-devel checks on Linux
R-release checks on macOS and Windows
exact source-archive smoke test and artifact hash verification
identity_limit: This is a deterministic D-curve fit to exact finite-population hypergeometric expected TTR. It is neither CLAN VOCD nor claimed compatible with CLAN or a historical Monte Carlo implementation.
maintainer_decision: approved for the recomposed 0.1.0 candidate subject to the ordinary cross-platform release gate
